name: imf_get_country_profile
description:
Five-indicator macro snapshot of one country from the IMF World Economic Outlook: GDP growth, inflation, unemployment, current account (% of GDP) and general government gross debt (% of GDP), over the last five years, from the IMF SDMX JSON data service (dataservices.imf.org, no API key).
Returns: country_code, country_name and indicators keyed by name, each with code, latest_value, latest_period and recent_data (up to the last three periods), or an error.
Inputs (* required): country_code* (ISO 2-letter, e.g. US, CN, DE).
For other indicators or a longer history use imf_get_weo_data; to compare countries imf_compare_countries.
Example: {"country_code": "BR"}

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Get a comprehensive economic snapshot for any country with key macroeconomic indicators.
